title: Resources Archive
html:
Explore a comprehensive archive of educational content to support your professional development – from insightful webinars to session recordings from past EOS congresses and virtual events – as well as useful materials from previous meetings and other sources*.

What are you looking for?

1. Type in the search bar to find anything – keywords, speaker names, and presentation titles
2. Apply filters to narrow results by category and/or content format
3. Click on a result to view full details
4. Rate the content you view to help us highlight what’s most relevant to members

Code of Conduct

By using this Resource Library, you agree to abide by our Code of Conduct. The European Orthodontic Society reserves the right to revoke your membership and access to the Library with immediate effect if the Code of Conduct is violated.
*The European Orthodontic Society is not responsible for the content or accuracy of external websites linked from this platform. The inclusion of external links does not constitute an endorsement of the linked content or associated products.

Do you have an idea for content?

Click here to submit your proposal to the EOS Education Committee.
This initiative is for you – our members! If your proposal is feasible, we will be in touch to discuss the next steps for inclusion in the Library.

To report any issues or ask for assistance, please click here.
